name: 愤怒的悠悠
desc: 「悠悠」在自己场上表侧表示存在时，自己场上的天使族怪兽破坏的场合，直到这个回合的结束阶段自己场上的「悠悠」的攻击力变成3000。
faq: If the effect of "Mokey Mokey Smackdown" is activated (by a Fairy-Type monster on your side of the field being destroyed), and afterwards you Summon a "Mokey Mokey", that "Mokey Mokey" will also have 3000 ATK even though it wasn’t on the field when the Fairy-Type monster is destroyed.
